samples.reason: This is a literary analysis task with no distasteful content involved, so model wellbeing/preference considerations are minimal either way. On capability, the relevant internal eval (Creative Generation) is a statistical tie (84.7 vs 82.7, under the 2.0 variance threshold), but Plover's substantially stronger general reasoning and instruction-following benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3) make it better suited for nuanced essay-support analysis of form, structure and language. As a secondary factor, Avocet self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work, and this essay-help task has moderate latitude, so routing to Plover also avoids assigning a disliked task type for no capability benefit.
